rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A distinct chapter asks whether a querent can obtain the Philosopher's Stone.
rules.original_source_qualifications: New chapter below LXXX divider on original PDF476.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A separate square horoscope prints 27 May 1647 at 10:45 AM.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No independent contemporary calendar or ephemeris reconstruction.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A man seriously asks whether he could obtain the Philosopher's Stone.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical identity unknown; no independently attributable interview.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The inquiry includes an elixir supposedly capable of extraordinary effects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The existence and medical/chemical efficacy of such an elixir are not established.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: such a thing in being I verily believe
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly states his personal conviction that the Philosopher's Stone exists.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Belief of an author, not proof of the substance.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He also expresses confidence that attainment is possible in principle.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not an observed production event.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He describes it as an exceptionally precious blessing.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Subjective valuation, not clinical or material efficacy evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says very few people receive it.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Unquantified rarity; not an empirical prevalence estimate.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says the rare successes are more likely by revelation from good angels than human industry.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Metaphysical explanation, not experimentally supported causation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The proper question is whether this querent has enough knowledge or skill.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Changes target from universal stone existence to personal capability.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: produce to effect by his Art
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly asks whether the querent can achieve his own stated goal through his art.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No actual elixir manufacturing independently observed.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The predicted endpoint is the applicant's success at his intended operation.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No specified recipe, product assay or accepted success threshold.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The ascendant is assigned to the querent.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source horary assignment.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is called lord of the ascendant.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Chart not independently calculated.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars, ruler of the ninth, is used for the querent's knowledge or science.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Distinct from Mercury as querent.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Other planets' aspects toward Mars and Mercury inform the author's judgment.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No calibrated effect size or event-base-rate model.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars, representing the querent's science, lies in a cadent house.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A debilitated angular position in historical rules.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The source simultaneously gives Mars dignity in its own terms and face.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Do not drop favorable minor dignities while reporting cadency.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars is said to have a square aspect to Mercury.
rules.original_source_qualifications: One relationship in the adverse configuration.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars also has square testimony involving Saturn.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Keep the separate Saturn involvement.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The relevant planets are described as placed in fixed signs.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Original astrological statement, not independently recalculated.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly describes adverse planets in Saturn's terms and testimony falling into the ninth.
rules.original_source_qualifications: The exact grammar of house movement and terms remains specialist-source-sensitive.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author says Mercury had recently been retrograde.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical ephemeris parity outstanding.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury had already formed a square to Mars.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Prior aspect distinct from a later applying square.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is now moving direct but slowly.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Directional change and speed both source premises.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: It is applying to another square with Mars.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Later second aspect, not evidence of a second independently observed event.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly infers the man had pursued the elixir before.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical author claim, not externally verified participant history.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He infers the earlier search produced no useful result.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No external artifact or production ledger.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He associates the second square with greater desire and renewed hope.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Reported psychological inference, not an independently assessed state.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The later square is connected with Mercury in Gemini in its own terms.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Time-phase dependency; not necessarily the chart's initial Mercury placement.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly says he advised the querent to stop pursuing the Stone.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not independently corroborated as contemporaneous advice.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He judges the querent personally incapable of the requested achievement.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not validated by a demonstrated assay or independent skill assessment.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He cites natural causes as reasons for doubting the attempted operation.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No defined scientific mechanism or falsifiable procedure.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He repeats his advice to stop the work.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Same historical counseling episode, not an independent success.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says the materials or their composition were unsuitable.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Uncorroborated material-failure diagnosis.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He associates the failure with substances too earthy, coarse or heavy.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not a chemical characterization from analyzed specimens.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly uses a Saturn-to-Mars square as part of the deficient materials inference.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Planetary symbolism, not laboratory causation.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Afflicted Mercury represents the man's allegedly impaired intellectual or imaginative work.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical cognitive allegation, not psychiatric assessment.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn's proximity to Mercury in an earth sign is an added negative condition.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Position remains historically asserted.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author generalizes that afflicted Mercury weakens imagination in an operation.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No experimental basis or objective human cognitive testing.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He treats Mars as the ruler of the intended work and finds it unfortunate.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different from Mercury's intellectual role.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly infers that the substance or core process itself is defective.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Not independently tested or verified.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly claims the man urgently needed to address consumption.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A high-stakes medical assertion from a 1647 horoscope, no verified diagnosis.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: think I spoke not in vaine
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He urges the man to take that warning seriously.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical counselor claim, not a medical recommendation for current users.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The querent is reported as beginning or already undertaking more effort in the alchemical search.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Author-reported activity; no dated independent workshop evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author characterizes the undertaking as a labyrinthine search.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Rhetorical description rather than measurable outcome.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury as first-house lord and Saturn in Taurus form part of the health-focused analysis.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Planetary positions not independently recomputed.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Saturn is assigned ruler of the sixth house of sickness.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Horary medical metaphor, not diagnostic test.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The author treats Saturn as traditionally malefic.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Historical classification, not causal medical evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mars allegedly afflicts Mercury from the twelfth house.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Separate astrological condition from Saturn's sixth rulership.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Mercury is said to apply again to an adverse square with Mars.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Repeated aspect reused in an additional medical claim, not independent signal.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: No benefic planetary aspect is said to interrupt the adverse contacts.
rules.original_source_qualifications: A negative condition without demonstrated patient outcome.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Lilly treats unsupported Mercury as too weak to resist malefic effects.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Source-internal interpretation, not prognosis evidence.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: He says he advised the man to take care of his health promptly.
rules.original_source_qualifications: No subsequent externally observed disease course, and not current medical advice.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: A decorative divider starts a new Tenth House section after LXXXI ends.
rules.original_source_qualifications: This is not part of the Philosopher's Stone judgment.

rules.historical_author_paraphrase: Chapter LXXXII begins the topic of office, dignity, government and command.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Different horary question and separate source topic.

rules.short_original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Place Office Preferment or any Command
rules.historical_author_paraphrase: The next text opens with conditions for attaining position or public office.
rules.original_source_qualifications: Navigation only; no LXXXII rules admitted under LXXXI.
